name: io.github.freeagentstore/mcp
description: AI agent tools for FreeAgentStore: browse the store, scaffold and edit browser-based AI agents in their GitHub repos, publish them to the store, and read the platform guide and SDK reference. Read tools are open; write tools require an authenticated owner.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: List all published agents, or just yours if authenticated

tools.name: agent_info
tools.description: Get info about an agent — live URL, repo, status

tools.name: deploy_status
tools.description: Check deploy status (last 5 GitHub Actions runs)

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List all files in an agent's repo

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a file from an agent's repo

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Search for text across all files in an agent's repo

tools.name: create_agent
tools.description: Provision a new agent: GitHub repo, template scaffold, D1 route with ownership (supports dry_run)

tools.name: update_files
tools.description: Write/overwrite files in an owned agent's repo as one commit; auto-deploys (supports dry_run)

tools.name: delete_file
tools.description: Delete a file from an owned agent's repo — requires confirm=<path> (supports dry_run)

tools.name: delete_agent
tools.description: Remove an owned agent from the store — irreversible, requires confirm=<agent_id> (supports dry_run)

tools.name: publish_to_store
tools.description: Add an owned agent to registry.json and trigger a store rebuild (supports dry_run)

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Show the authenticated identity and whether the server is in read-only mode

tools.name: mcp_audit_log
tools.description: Read your recent MCP audit events (writes, dry-runs, blocked, failed), newest first

tools.name: platform_guide
tools.description: How to build autonomous browser agents on FreeAgentStore

tools.name: sdk_reference
tools.description: Reference for agent tools, inference, MCP, search, fetch, and config
